description_en:
Translates documents with a solution designed specifically for document translation. It supports over 150 languages and provides pivot translation capabilities with thousands of pivot combinations. It handles multi-scenario, multi-page, and highly complex document translation, but does not currently support scanned documents. It excels in the following aspects:
Content accuracy: translation accuracy, and accuracy of parameters and units.
Structural integrity: overall layout continuity, and restoration of page margins and layouts
description_zh:
专为文档翻译研发，支持150多个语言的翻译，并提供了桥接翻译能力，多达数千种桥接组合。满足多场景&多页数&高复杂度文档翻译，暂不支持扫描件。
在以下方面表现出色：
· 内容准确性：翻译准确性，参数与单位准确性
· 结构合理性：整体排版连续性，页面边距与布局还原性

name: DocumentTranslate

parameters.help_en: The OSS URL path of the document to be translated
parameters.help_zh: 待翻译文档的OSS URL路径
parameters.name: url

parameters.help_en: Supports PDF, WORD, and EXCEL formats. Use uppercase letters when specifying this parameter
parameters.help_zh: 支持PDF，WORD，EXCEL三种格式，建议入参时使用大写格式
parameters.name: file_type

parameters.help_en:
● Specify the intervention glossary ID when the intervention feature is required.   
● Supports custom translation results, including:   
○ Do-not-translate (ABC-ABC).   
○ Specified translation (ABC-DEF).   
○ Translation omission (ABC-null value).
This is commonly used in scenarios such as brand word protection.   
Example value: "glossary_1"
parameters.help_zh:
● 需要干预功能时填写干预词表 ID   
● 支持自定义翻译结果，包含   
○ 不被翻译（ABC-ABC）；   
○ 指定翻译（ABC-DEF）；   
○ 不翻译（ABC-空值）
常用于品牌词保护等场景   
示例值："glossary_1"
parameters.name: glossary
